home.heading: Choose a tool
home.intro: A collection of utilities for developers and administrators, built as an accessibility reference for visually impaired users.
home.a11yText: Full keyboard navigation, screen-reader friendly, a minimum 7:1 contrast ratio and three themes. Use the skip link to jump straight to the content.

base-converter.name: Programmer calculator
base-converter.desc: Convert between hexadecimal, decimal, octal and binary and view bit operations.
base-converter.invalid: Invalid number for the selected base

ip-calculator.name: IP subnet calculator
ip-calculator.desc: Compute network, broadcast, host range and convert between CIDR prefix and netmask (round trip).
ip-calculator.note: Edit the prefix or the netmask — both stay in sync in both directions.

chmod.name: chmod calculator
chmod.desc: Convert permissions between octal (e.g. 755) and symbolic (rwxr-xr-x), both directions.
chmod.example: Example: 777 = rwxrwxrwx (full access). Toggle the boxes or type the octal value.

jwt.name: JWT decoder
jwt.desc: Decode the header and payload of a JSON Web Token (signature not verified).

base64.name: Base64
base64.desc: Encode and decode text to and from Base64.

url.name: URL encoder
url.desc: Encode and decode URL components with percent-encoding.

hash.name: Hash generator
hash.desc: Generate SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 hashes of your text.

timestamp.name: Timestamp converter
timestamp.desc: Convert between Unix timestamp and human-readable date/time.

json.name: JSON formatter
json.desc: Validate and pretty-print (or minify) JSON documents.

contrast.name: Contrast checker
contrast.desc: Compute the contrast ratio between two colors and check WCAG compliance.

whois.name: WHOIS
whois.desc: Look up registration information for a domain or IP.

ping.name: Ping
ping.desc: Check the availability and latency of a host.

traceroute.name: Traceroute
traceroute.desc: Trace the network route to a host.

dns.name: DNS lookup
dns.desc: Resolve DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS and others).

http.name: HTTP inspector
http.desc: Make an HTTP request and inspect status, headers and body (curl-style).

linux.name: Linux commands
linux.desc: Quick reference for essential Linux shell commands: files, search, permissions and processes.

docker.name: Docker commands
docker.desc: Docker quick reference: containers, images, lifecycle and cleanup.

kubernetes.name: Kubernetes commands
kubernetes.desc: kubectl quick reference: resource inspection, namespaces, usage (top), deploy and cluster operations.

ffmpeg.name: ffmpeg commands
ffmpeg.desc: ffmpeg examples to convert video and audio, resize, trim and create GIFs.

magick.name: magick commands
magick.desc: ImageMagick examples to convert, resize, crop and optimize images.

pkg.name: Package managers
pkg.desc: Basic Homebrew, apt and winget usage to install and update packages (with links).

powershell.name: PowerShell commands
powershell.desc: PowerShell from basic to advanced: files, pipeline, web, remoting and error handling.

azure-cli.name: Azure CLI (az)
azure-cli.desc: az examples: login, resources, VMs, AKS, web apps and storage.

aws-cli.name: AWS CLI (aws)
aws-cli.desc: AWS CLI from basic to advanced: S3, EC2, logs, IAM, CloudFormation and EKS (with examples).

cpf.name: CPF (generate & validate)
cpf.desc: Generate a valid CPF for testing and validate the check digit of a CPF (Brazilian taxpayer ID).

cnpj.name: CNPJ (generate & validate)
cnpj.desc: Generate a valid CNPJ for testing and validate the check digit of a CNPJ (Brazilian company ID).
